summary: Surf Air Mobility filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, attaching a legal opinion tied to a prospectus supplement dated September 29, 2026, under its Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-291485). The supplement registers issuance of 4,644,922 common shares as consideration for license fees and related professional services rendered by Palantir Technologies Inc. under an existing software license agreement. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is an ordinary shelf takedown for services payment, not a special situation; watch dilution and registration effectiveness.
